title: Neuroscientist's Guide To 10X Your Focus & Memory
author: Dr. Sahar Yousef · Raj Shamani (FO559)
quotes: Your brain is designed to look for data that confirms your beliefs.|Every time you switch your attention, you pay for it in time and energy.|Be bored and do nothing, and you get ideas.|Stress doesn't kill. Never completing the stress cycle kills.|Your phone lowers your fluid intelligence even when it's switched off and face down.|Write your story from the version of you that already believes in yourself — then review it every day.|When X happens, then I do Y — vague goals are prayers, not plans.|3M breaks: 10 min daily, 2 hours weekly, half a day monthly — with complete psychological detachment.
